## Appearance

Nell begins as a pale, thin, and freckled girl with two long braids of intense red hair and wide gray-green eyes. As she matures, she grows tall, slender, and elegant, with her hair darkening into a rich auburn shade that she wears in soft ringlets or braided coils. Her face becomes fair and refined, with clear skin, fine features, and a small, pointed, attractive nose.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P13](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0013), [v1 c9 P13](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0013), [v1 c10 P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034), [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c28 P6](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0006), [v1 c30 P6](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0006), [v1 c31 P15](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0015), [v2 c1 P0](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0000), [v2 c27 P31](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0031), [v3 c25 P34](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0034), [v4 c1 P0](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0000)_

## Personality

Nell is intensely imaginative, romantic, and expressive, perpetually naming her surroundings and creating elaborate daydreams. She possesses a fervent, fiery temper when her appearance or dignity is insulted, but she is equally quick to feel deep remorse and forgive others. Deeply affectionate, loyal, and generous, she forms passionate friendships and holds strongly to her ideals and sense of duty. Though prone to dramatic outbursts and impulsive mistakes, she matures into a thoughtful, resilient, and dedicated woman who finds joy in the beauty of life and the service of those she loves.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P19](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0019), [v1 c2 P37](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0037), [v1 c2 P53](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0053), [v1 c7 P12](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0012), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c10 P16](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0016), [v1 c12 P46](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0046), [v1 c17 P4](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0004), [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003), [v1 c31 P23](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0023), [v1 c38 P25](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0025), [v2 c30 P3](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0003), [v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030), [v4 c1 P3](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0003)_

## History

Brought to Grey Shutters by mistake instead of an orphan boy, Nell wins over Obed and Thirza Abernethy through her vivid chatter and warm heart, persuading them to let her stay. She makes a lifelong bosom friend in Isolde Pembroke, naming local landmarks like Linger Lane and the Lake of Glassy Waters. Though initially behind in school, she competes fiercely with Hugh Carrow, eventually advancing to Regent's Academy and winning the prestigious Avery Scholarship. When a lost brooch incident and a hair-dyeing mishap cause temporary crises, Nell shows her resilience and dedication to her foster family, even giving up college initially to stay at Grey Shutters and teach at Brierley School when Thirza's eyesight fails and Obed dies of a heart attack. After Thirza arranges for Agatha Sowerby to move in, Nell attends Wexcombe College, winning the Thorburn Scholarship and founding a household at Tabby's Place with her friends. She rejects proposals from Barney Pullen, Wilfred Mott, and Cyril Lisle, realizing her true love is Hugh Carrow. They marry in the Grey Shutters orchard and move to Seven Gulls Harbor, where Nell gives birth to a daughter, Joyce, who dies in infancy, and later a son, Little Kit. She continues her writing, publishing stories in magazines, and remains a beloved figure in the community.

_Sources: [v1 c3 P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c15 P4](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0004), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c27 P30](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0030), [v1 c36 P7](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0007), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c38 P18](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0018), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 c27 P33](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0033), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c9 P3](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0003), [v3 c36 P7](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0007), [v3 c38 P18](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0018), [v4 c4 P15](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0015), [v4 c19 P0](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0000), [v4 c34 P0](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0000)_

## Background by volume

- Orphaned as an infant at three months old after both her parents died of fever  <sub>[v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013)</sub>
- Raised by Mrs. Thomas until age eight, helping care for her children  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- Lived with Mrs. Rudge for over two years, caring for her eight children and three sets of twins  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v1 c5 P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015)</sub>
- Spent four months in the Marden orphan asylum before being brought to Grey Shutters  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c5 P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015)</sub>
- Adopted by Thirza and Obed Abernethy after a mix-up over an intended orphan boy  <sub>[v1 c3 P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031)</sub>

> My life is a perfect graveyard of buried hopes.  <sub>[v1 c5 P3](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0003)</sub>

> It’s been a long time since I used to be a small girl, but I think that when I am by myself I am just as much a small girl as ever I was.  <sub>[v2 c10 P4](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0004)</sub>
